definition.body:
SELECT d.document_id, d.filename, d.doc_type, d.review_status,
       COUNT(ii.instance_id) AS instances
FROM documents d
LEFT JOIN instance_index ii ON ii.document_id = d.document_id
WHERE d.review_status = 'unreviewed'
GROUP BY d.document_id
ORDER BY d.date_added DESC

display.name: Unconfirmed findings at or below the inferred rubric level

definition.body:
SELECT i.type_id, i.instance_id, i.document_id, p.excerpt, p.confidence
FROM instance_index i
JOIN provenance p ON p.instance_id = i.instance_id
WHERE p.confidence <= 0.5
ORDER BY p.confidence ASC, i.created_at DESC

display.name: Analyses invalidated by a later amendment

definition.body:
SELECT evaluation_id, concept_id, kind, target_document_id,
       stale_reason, generated_at
FROM concept_evaluations
WHERE stale = 1
ORDER BY generated_at DESC

display.name: What has been sent to the cloud model

definition.body:
SELECT c.created_at, c.purpose, c.document_id, d.filename,
       c.actor_id, c.prompt_chars, c.excerpt_only, c.model
FROM llm_calls c
LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.document_id = c.document_id
WHERE c.tier = 'cloud'
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

display.name: Does the confidence rubric actually rank reliability?

definition.body:
-- Joins through provenance, which is what keeps rule-raised flags out:
-- a concept flag has no provenance row, because it is not an extraction.
-- Give concept flags provenance and this starts reporting rule
-- precision as extraction accuracy.
SELECT p.confidence,
       COUNT(*) AS reviewed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN x.status = 'confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN x.status = 'amended'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amended,
       SUM(CASE WHEN x.status = 'rejected'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected,
       ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN x.status = 'confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / COUNT(*), 3) AS accuracy
FROM provenance p
JOIN (
{{instanceUnion}}
) x ON x.instance_id = p.instance_id
WHERE x.status IN ('confirmed', 'amended', 'rejected')
GROUP BY p.confidence
ORDER BY p.confidence DESC

SELECT seq, edited_at, edited_by, table_name, row_id, action,
       previous_value, new_value, note
FROM edit_history
WHERE action IN ('amend', 'confirm', 'reject')
ORDER BY seq DESC

display.name: How often does each rule concept point at something real?

definition.body:
SELECT flag_type AS concept_id,
       COUNT(*) AS raised,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('confirmed', 'amended') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upheld,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'unconfirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreviewed
FROM instances_Flag
WHERE raised_by_pass = 'concept'
GROUP BY flag_type
ORDER BY dismissed DESC

templates.baseSqlExpr: value_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(value_amount AS REAL) >= {{threshold}}

display.description: Contract value at or above a configurable review threshold.
Value at or above which a contract is treated as high value, in the contract's own currency.

display.name: High value
display.description: Headline value at or above the review threshold.

concepts.sqlExpr: value_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(value_amount AS REAL) >= 1000000
concepts.rationale: Threshold is a deployment setting, not a fact. Override it with orph_set_concept_parameter().

display.name: Missing signature block
display.description: No signature block was found in the document.

concepts.rationale: A contract with no signature block needs a human to confirm execution.
Distinguishing a genuinely open-ended term from a failed extraction is exactly what human review is for.

Matches the closed OCDS procurementMethod codelist rather than guessing at phrasings. A contract whose procedure is recorded outside the codelist is reported by orph_codelist_violations(), not silently missed here.

display.name: Uncapped liability
display.description: A liability clause with no cap language.

concepts.sqlExpr: clause_type = 'liability' AND LOWER(COALESCE(text,'')) NOT LIKE '%cap%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(text,'')) NOT LIKE '%limited to%'
concepts.rationale: Coarse by design: it over-selects, and review narrows it.

display.name: Automatic renewal
display.description: A clause that renews the agreement without a positive decision.

concepts.sqlExpr: LOWER(COALESCE(text,'')) LIKE '%automatically renew%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(text,'')) LIKE '%unless terminated%'
concepts.rationale: Auto-renewal is a common source of unintended spend.

scores.description: Weighted count of the risk concepts a contract triggers.
